name: Prithvi Dharmaraj
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years building payment infrastructure at Amazon Pay, specializing in tokenization, card network integrations, and agentic payment systems. Experienced in designing high availability transaction systems with a focus on security and developer experience.

experience.title: Software Engineer 2
accomplishments: Led agentic tokenization orchestration efforts for Amazon Pay, improving payment method acceptance for Amazon Agentic AI products for off-Amazon experiences including Buy For Me and Alexa+.
Designed and owned key features of the external transaction management system that provides internal risk and fraud detection layers better visibility into off-Amazon agentic transactions.

experience.title: Software Engineer 1
accomplishments: Led a team of 8 engineers to simplify the Amazon Pay integration experience through designing and implementing a network token life-cycle management system which allows for payment service providers to integrate with Amazon Pay with minimal effort.
Owned technical communication with card networks (Visa, Mastercard, Discover) to implement and align on an integration pattern for Amazon Pay to use on their tokenization platforms (e.g. VTS, MDES).
Increased merchant adoption rate by migrating PSD2 MFA handling from legacy architecture to support new Amazon Pay product launches.
Designed a discrepancy handling system for transaction invoices sent from payment service providers (e.g. Stripe) for settlements to notify internal stakeholders of invoicing issues.

experience.title: Research Engineer
accomplishments: Improved the in-development digital radar system by creating custom internal libraries for networking protocols such as Telnet and Data Distribution Service in C++.
Redesigned the radar metric ingestion system by developing an internal high-throughput HDF5 C++ library.
